reason: An agreement in principle with Eurobond holders was announced on 25 March 2024 and finalised in June 2024, restructuring approximately $3 billion in bonds with a ~21.6% nominal haircut; Zambia was confirmed as the first country to complete the G20 Common Framework process.

title: Severe Drought and Record Power Crisis
reason: The 2023–24 El Niño brought Zambia's worst drought in decades; Hichilema declared a National Disaster in February 2024, schools were temporarily closed, load-shedding reached up to 21 hours per day, and Kariba dam held only 4.9% of usable water for generation by October 2024.
